name: outreach-skills
description: Outreach Skills brings your live Outreach insights, actions, and revenue workflows into generative AI assistants, so sellers, managers, and CSMs can go from question to action without leaving the assistant they already work in.

interface.longDescription: Outreach Skills brings your live Outreach data and 21 ready-made revenue workflows into the AI assistant your team already uses. One install adds the secure Outreach connection, the workflows, and, where the assistant supports them, visual views. Sellers, managers, CSMs, and RevOps go from question to action without switching tools, and the assistant can use Outreach alongside the other connectors your team has added. The first run sets itself up from your Outreach data: you just confirm your company, offering, buyers, and voice. Each person signs in with their own Outreach login, so the assistant sees only what they can see. It confirms exact details before any change, never deletes records as part of a workflow, and a view changes nothing in Outreach until you confirm it.
defaultPrompt: Run my pipeline review for this quarter.
